name: Laibin
registryBasis: The official Laibin Natural Resources Bureau site (来宾市自然资源局) is the local natural-resources custodian. The official Guangxi Tianditu layer registry also publishes a province-wide real-estate data group whose parcel layer is described as Guangxi cadastral parcel and natural-building polygons; this evidences a public map service, not title or ownership access.
